# Flow 8: building the universe: galaxy, system, planet, resources and callsigns.
#
# The hierarchy the Captain builds, with real integrations behind the resources. The first scan of
# a real integration asks the Captain before it runs anything, so a client answers once and
# trusts the commands; after that the same scans run without a prompt, as they do in daily use.

step set up the vessel so the resources are real
exec orbiter --output json vessel init -y

step a galaxy, a system in it, a planet in the galaxy and a planet in the system
exec orbiter galaxy add acme-corp
stdout 'galaxy.*acme-corp.*registered'
exec orbiter survey acme-corp
stdout 'entity'
stdout 'acme-corp'
stdout 'unverified'
exec orbiter system add frontend --galaxy acme-corp
stdout 'system.*frontend.*registered'
exec orbiter survey frontend
stdout 'frontend'
exec orbiter planet add payments-api --galaxy acme-corp
stdout 'planet.*payments-api.*registered'
exec orbiter planet add auth-service --galaxy acme-corp --system frontend
stdout 'planet.*auth-service.*registered'
exec orbiter survey auth-service
stdout 'auth-service'

step an empty planet has nothing to scan or chart
exec orbiter survey payments-api
stdout 'resources.*0'
stdout 'transponders.*0'
exec orbiter scan payments-api
stdout 'no resources attached'
exec orbiter chart payments-api
stdout 'no resources to chart'

step register two resources and attach them to the planet
exec orbiter resource add git-tool --role tool --brand git
stdout 'resource.*git-tool.*registered'
stdout 'tool/git'
exec orbiter attach git-tool payments-api
stdout 'attached'
exec orbiter survey payments-api
stdout 'resources.*1'
exec orbiter resource add go-runtime --role runtime --brand golang
exec orbiter attach go-runtime payments-api
exec orbiter survey payments-api
stdout 'resources.*2'

step the first scan asks the Captain, who approves and trusts the commands
client -- scan payments-api
stdout '"role":"tool","brand":"git"'
stdout '"role":"runtime","brand":"golang"'

step trusted, the same scan runs without a prompt and shows both resources
exec orbiter scan payments-api
stdout 'tool/git'
stdout 'runtime/go'

step a callsign holds the transponders that give access to things
exec orbiter callsign add acme-keys
stdout 'callsign.*acme-keys.*registered'
exec orbiter survey acme-keys
stdout 'callsign'
stdout 'transponders.*0'
exec orbiter transponder add corp-gh --role file --brand github --location /tmp/token
stdout 'transponder.*corp-gh.*registered'
stdout 'file/github'
exec orbiter attach corp-gh acme-keys
stdout 'attached'
exec orbiter survey acme-keys
stdout 'transponders.*1'
exec orbiter scan acme-keys
stdout 'file/github'

step the callsign flows down: attached to a planet, its transponders are visible there
exec orbiter attach acme-keys payments-api
stdout 'attached'
exec orbiter scan payments-api
stdout 'tool/git'
exec orbiter survey payments-api
stdout 'transponders.*[1-9]'

step a callsign on a galaxy flows down to a planet that has none of its own
exec orbiter galaxy add beta-corp
exec orbiter callsign add beta-keys
exec orbiter transponder add beta-gh --role file --brand github --location /tmp/beta-token
exec orbiter attach beta-gh beta-keys
exec orbiter attach beta-keys beta-corp
exec orbiter planet add beta-api --galaxy beta-corp
exec orbiter scan beta-api
stdout 'file/github|no resources attached'

step a transponder attached directly to a planet is seen next to the inherited callsign
exec orbiter transponder add direct-gitea --role file --brand gitea --location /tmp/gitea-token
exec orbiter attach direct-gitea beta-api
exec orbiter scan beta-api
stdout 'file/github'
stdout 'file/gitea'
